item.title: EPL: Sol Campbell predicts Arsenal vs Chelsea game, names team to win title

item.title: FCT polls: Why there was no violence – CDD
item.description: The Centre for Democracy and Development, CDD, has attributed the peace nature of the just concluded Federal Capital Territory, FCT, Area Councils election to the low voter turnout. item.title: Bandits kill driver, abduct eight passengers in Kaduna community
item.description: Bandits opened fire at a commercial vehicle at the Sabon-Kuruti junction in Kachia local government area of Kaduna state and shot the driver of the vehicle, Joshua Atara to death and abducted eight passengers. item.title: UCL Playoffs: Osimhen returns to training ahead Juventus vs Galatasaray

item.title: Police recover arms, neutralize bandits in Kaduna
item.description: As part of efforts to curb banditry, kidnapping and illegal arms proliferation in the state, the police authority in Kaduna said, its personnel have neutralised several bandits and recovered about 30 firearms during a two-week offensive targeting criminal networks across the state. item.title: Lagos launches aerial surveillance patrols to boost crime fighting
item.description: The Lagos State Security Trust Fund has launched aerial surveillance operations across Lagos in partnership with the Nigeria Police Force Airwing Command, to strengthen crime prevention and public safety in the state.
